about.title: About {app}
about.body:
{app} v{version}

Installs, runs and maintains games on desktop Linux and SteamOS, through Steam or standalone (umu-run + UMU-Proton), with saves, runtimes and cleanup.

License: MIT License
Author: Murilo Giatti
Repository: github.com/murilogiatti/DeckInstall

Translations live in locales/*.json. English is the primary language.

mode.label: Runs with:
mode.desc_steam: Steam runs the game with its own Proton, runtime and performance overlay. DeckInstall installs it, adds the Steam shortcut and downloads nothing else.
mode.desc_standalone: DeckInstall runs the game itself with umu-run and UMU-Proton, from the Library, the app menu or the desktop. Steam is not needed.
mode.note_standalone_steamos: On SteamOS games always run through Steam, so Standalone mode is not offered.
mode.note_steam_missing: Steam was not found, so only Standalone mode is available.
mode.note_mangohud_steam: Not used in Steam mode: Steam (and SteamOS through gamescope) already has a built-in performance overlay.
mode.note_shortcuts_steam: In Steam mode the game opens from Steam, so no menu or desktop launcher is created.
runtimes.note_proton_steamos: SteamOS already ships Valve's Proton; nothing to download.
runtimes.note_umu_steamos: Only used by Standalone mode, which SteamOS does not offer.
runtimes.note_mangohud_steamos: SteamOS already has a performance overlay (gamescope); nothing to install.
runtimes.nothing_to_update: Nothing to update: no runtime in use on this system.
runtimes.proton_about: Runs Windows games. Steam-mode games use the Proton chosen in Steam; Standalone games use UMU-Proton.
runtimes.umu_about: Start Standalone games in Valve's runtime container, outside Steam.
runtimes.mangohud_about: Performance overlay for Standalone games (Steam has its own).
runtimes.optiscaler_about: Swaps the game's DLSS, FSR 2+ or XeSS for another upscaler. Only games that ship one can use it.
runtimes.status_not_downloaded: not downloaded (it is downloaded when first installed on a game)
runtimes.tools_about: Optional programs of this system that DeckInstall calls when they exist: 7-Zip unpacks OptiScaler, innoextract opens GOG offline installers without running them, and gamemoderun is the system performance mode. DeckInstall never installs them without asking.
runtimes.note_standalone_only: Only for Standalone games; Steam-mode games use Steam's.
add.confirm_standalone_runtime:
Standalone mode needs umu-run and UMU-Proton (about 500 MB), which are not installed yet.

Download them now?
mode.note_steam_shortcut_standalone: In Standalone mode the game opens from the Library, the menu or the desktop, so it is not added to Steam.
mode.switch_confirm_steam:
Run '{name}' with Steam from now on?

DeckInstall adds the Steam shortcut (it uses the game's own prefix, so saves stay) and removes the app menu and desktop launchers. MangoHud is left out: Steam has its own performance overlay. Steam will be closed for the change.
mode.switch_confirm_standalone:
Run '{name}' standalone from now on?

DeckInstall removes the game's Steam shortcut and creates the app menu launcher (and the Desktop one, if the game had it before going to Steam). Game files, prefix and saves stay. If umu-run and UMU-Proton (about 500 MB) are not installed yet, they are downloaded first. Steam will be closed for the change.
mode.switch_gaming_mode: Switch the mode in Desktop Mode: Steam has to be closed for the change.

cleanup.cat_game_prefix: Game prefix without a registered game
cleanup.cat_game_logs: Game logs without a registered game

launch.raw_hint: The preview shows the generated command. In Steam, %command% stands for the original game command.

saves.restore_older_warning: Warning: the saves on disk now ({current}) are newer than this snapshot ({snap}). Restoring takes the game back to that older point. A safety snapshot of the current saves is made first.
sgdb.tip: Optional: with your free SteamGridDB API key, games get covers, banners and logos the Steam store does not have (Library > Artwork).
sgdb.prompt:
SteamGridDB API key (steamgriddb.com > Preferences > API).
Leave empty to stop using SteamGridDB.
hooks.title: Commands for {name}
hooks.intro: Optional shell commands DeckInstall runs from the game's launcher (Standalone mode): one before the game starts and one after it closes. They run in the game's folder with its environment; their output goes to the game's run log.
library.empty_body: Install a game from a folder or archive, or adopt games that are already on this computer.
library.no_results_body: Try another search term or clear the active filter.
updates.title: Updates
updates.auto: Check once a day when DeckInstall opens
updates.offline: GitHub could not be reached just now: showing the last known versions
updates.will_install: not installed, needed for Standalone mode
updates.reason_not_appimage: running outside the AppImage: update with git/pip
updates.reason_not_writable: the AppImage file is read-only: download it from the site
updates.reason_no_asset: no AppImage published for this release yet
updates.reason_no_checksum: no checksum published: download it from the site
updates.wait: Wait a minute before checking again (GitHub limits how often apps can ask).
updates.err_rate_limit: GitHub is limiting checks right now; try again later
settings.scale_restart: The new interface size takes effect the next time DeckInstall opens.
settings.steam_account_hint: Choose which Steam account receives shortcuts and artwork when more than one account is logged in on this PC or Steam Deck.
welcome.text: Welcome to DeckInstall! Install a game from a folder or archive on the Install tab. Settings keeps Proton, umu-run and DeckInstall itself up to date (Updates & runtimes) and has the theme, language and a bigger interface for the Deck. Ctrl+Tab moves between tabs.
saves.section_games_hint: Pick a game to keep a copy now, go back to an earlier copy or open its saves folder.
saves.backup_hint: Makes a .zip with the saves of every game, to keep off this device.
saves.restore_hint: Puts back the saves from a .zip made with the button above.
saves.sync_hint: Keeps a folder (Syncthing, SD card, another PC) with the same saves as here, both ways. Shows what would change first.
saves.import_hint: Brings the saves of every game in a Ludusavi backup. Games that are not installed are kept until you install them; repeated imports are dropped.
saves.export_hint: Writes this game's saves in Ludusavi's format.
library.btn_reload_tip: Reads Steam shortcuts, DeckInstall games and other launchers again.
art.btn_missing_hint: Downloads from SteamGridDB the covers, banners and logos the Library games lack. Uses your free key (Settings > General).
art.replace_prompt: '{name}' already has artwork. Swap it for SteamGridDB's? The current images are kept in a backup.
art.nothing_missing: Every game already has its artwork.
art.running: Fetching artwork for {count} game(s) from SteamGridDB...
art.steam_restart: Steam shows the new images after it restarts.
art.key_refused: SteamGridDB refused the API key. Check it in Settings > General.
install.source_hint: An installer or archive runs or is extracted into the library chosen in step 3, then Continue goes to step 2. A ready-to-play game folder goes straight to step 2.
settings.redetect_hint: Use it after installing Steam or signing in to it.
maint.cleanup_hint: Safe cleanup only deletes caches, leftovers without an owner and prefixes whose saves are already kept.
hooks.hint: A terminal command to run before the game opens and another after it closes.
configure.view_log_hint: What the game printed in its last runs: the first place to look when it does not open.
configure.card_prefix_hint: The folder where Wine keeps this game's "Windows": registry, installed dependencies and often the saves.
configure.winetricks_hint: Visual C++, DirectX, .NET and other pieces a game asks for, plus the Wine settings and registry editor.
configure.optiscaler_hint: Swaps the game's upscaler (DLSS, FSR, XeSS) for one this GPU runs, with optional frame generation.
configure.run_exe_hint: Runs an installer, patch or mod (.exe or .msi) inside this game's prefix.
winetricks.tools_hint: They open right away inside this prefix; nothing is installed.
winetricks.presets_hint: Tick what the game asks for: an error about a missing DLL usually names it.
optiscaler.options_hint: Automatic picks what fits this game and GPU; change only what the game's guide asks for.
launch.optiscaler_after_install: Available once the game is installed (Library > Configure > Launch).
launch.need_nvidia_driver: Needs NVIDIA's own driver: with nouveau/NVK, DLSS and NVAPI do not exist.
launch.optiscaler_cachyos: This game uses Proton-CachyOS, which can set up OptiScaler by itself: use one or the other, not both.
hw.title: This computer:
hw.note_hybrid: Two GPUs: games run on {primary} unless sent to {dedicated} (Configure > GPU).
hw.note_nouveau: The NVIDIA card uses the free nouveau/NVK driver: games run slower and DLSS/NVAPI do not exist. Install NVIDIA's driver for games.
hw.note_intel_mesa: Mesa {version}: Mesa 26.1 or newer makes DirectX 12 games faster on Intel GPUs. Update the system when you can.
settings.fps_hint: The frame cap a game starts with when it is installed; each game can change it in Configure. “Half the screen” and “Same as the screen” use the rate of the screen DeckInstall is on.
rec.from_valve: From Valve's Proton: it applies this only to games bought on Steam, not to shortcuts.
rec.from_umu: From umu (protonfixes), translated so it works with any Proton.
rec.umu_automatic: umu applies this game's protonfixes by itself in Standalone mode.
rec.umu_advanced: Part of umu's fix is only done by UMU-Proton or umu (it installs winetricks packages or changes files, the registry or the executable).
rec.optiscaler: This game only has DLSS, which this GPU cannot run: OptiScaler (More options > Upscaler) can give it FSR or XeSS instead.
settings.prefs_hint: The interface size applies the next time DeckInstall opens. Each game can change its frame cap in Configure; the SteamGridDB key is optional and brings covers the Steam store does not have.
install.rescan_tip: Searches the game folders again (Settings > Preferences > Game folders).
proton_bulk.target_download_umu: Download / update to the newest UMU-Proton (GitHub)
runtimes.components_hint: What runs your games. Point at a name to see what it is for; what this system does not need is greyed out with the reason.
opt.gamemode_hint: Asks Linux to give the game CPU and GPU priority while it runs (Feral GameMode; needs the gamemode package). Adds gamemoderun.
opt.mangohud_hint: Draws a panel over the game with FPS, frame time, CPU, GPU and memory (MangoHud). MANGOHUD=1
opt.local_shader_cache_hint: Keeps compiled shaders in a folder of this game only, so it stutters less the next times. Most useful outside Steam. PROTON_LOCAL_SHADER_CACHE=1
opt.disable_nvapi_hint: Hides the NVIDIA library that enables DLSS and Reflex. Use it when a game freezes or closes at start on an NVIDIA card. PROTON_DISABLE_NVAPI=1
opt.hide_nvidia_gpu: Show the NVIDIA card as AMD
opt.hide_nvidia_gpu_hint: The game sees an AMD card. Helps games that refuse to start, or take a broken path, on NVIDIA. PROTON_HIDE_NVIDIA_GPU=1
opt.vendor_amd: Show the Intel card as AMD
opt.vendor_amd_hint: For games that block or run badly on Intel Arc/Xe cards. DXVK_CONFIG=dxgi.customVendorId=1002
opt.descriptor_heap_hint: A newer VKD3D-Proton path that can speed up DirectX 12 games on NVIDIA cards with driver 595 or newer. VKD3D_CONFIG=descriptor_heap
opt.wined3d_hint: For DirectX 9 to 11 games that do not start or draw wrongly with DXVK. Usually slower. PROTON_USE_WINED3D=1
opt.no_fsync_hint: For games that hang or freeze: Proton uses another way to synchronize. PROTON_NO_FSYNC=1
opt.no_ntsync_hint: Use it if the game hangs only on systems with NTSYNC (Linux 6.14 or newer); Proton goes back to fsync. PROTON_NO_NTSYNC=1
opt.dxvk_d3d8_hint: Runs old DirectX 8 games with DXVK instead of OpenGL: usually more FPS and fewer drawing errors. PROTON_DXVK_D3D8=1
opt.no_d3d11_hint: Makes the game fall back to DirectX 9 or 10 when its DirectX 11 mode has problems. PROTON_NO_D3D11=1
opt.heap_delay_free_hint: Frees memory later, to work around buggy games that close by themselves (using memory already freed). PROTON_HEAP_DELAY_FREE=1
opt.old_gl_string_hint: Shortens the list of OpenGL extensions the game is told about; fixes very old games that close at start. PROTON_OLD_GL_STRING=1
opt.integer_scaling_hint: In full screen at a resolution lower than the screen's, scales up by whole pixels, without blur (good for pixel art). WINE_FULLSCREEN_INTEGER_SCALING=1
opt.no_xalia_hint: Xalia lets you use the controller in the game's windows and launchers. Turn it off if it gets in the way of the mouse or keyboard. PROTON_USE_XALIA=0
opt.dxgi_hint: Loads the dxgi.dll in the game folder (ReShade, OptiScaler and mods) instead of Proton's. WINEDLLOVERRIDES=dxgi=n,b
opt.debug_log_hint: Writes a large umu-run and Proton log to investigate a problem; the game runs slower, so turn it off afterwards. UMU_LOG=1, PROTON_LOG=1
cleanup.saves_copied: Saves of {copied} game(s) were kept first, so their prefixes can be cleaned safely.
add.presets_after: {opts} (the options used last; change them later in the Library under Configure)
library.bulk_proton_hint: Moves several games to another Proton at once (or back to the default, UMU-Proton).
library.bulk_optiscaler_hint: Installs or updates OptiScaler in every game that ships DLSS, FSR 2+ or XeSS.
winetricks.needs_umu_proton: Winetricks comes with UMU-Proton and runs inside the game's own container: choose UMU-Proton for this game (Configure > Proton) to use it.
